say:12:1660109009:1.source_cn: 希望他的容貌也能和因度厄媲美，给那些生活在暗无天日之地...

say:15:1660109012:1.text: Take Indris. A report is a lot more pleasant when delivered by someone lovely—somehow the most troublesome matters feel easier to untangle.

say:3:1660112003:0.text: Machinery! That's the highest form of art! Why can't you see it?

say:4:1660112004:0.text: For once, Hugin's speaking sense. I'll show you my mechanical hound one day, Damian. Peak craftsmanship. Truly.
say:4:1660112004:0.source_cn: 这一点呼金说的没错。小达米安，等下次有机会，我一定要带...

say:5:1660112005:0.text: Gears, stone bricks, tin plating... no, no, no!
say:5:1660112005:0.source_cn: 不……不行！春鲜集市的墙上不能布满齿轮！

say:6:1660112006:1.text: That's not Bloomtide Market. That doesn't fit Avalon at all!
say:6:1660112006:1.source_cn: 呃，还有石砖、铁皮之类的……都不行！这一点都不符合阿瓦...

say:7:1660112007:1.text: The finest designs are already written in nature. Wood grain, petal patterns... those are what we should preserve!
say:7:1660112007:1.source_cn: 要我说的话，最好的装饰都都来源于大自然。木头的纹理，花...

say:8:1660112008:1.text: Sounds like a typical Wilder. Tell me, how does it serve the Bloomtide Market?
say:8:1660112008:1.source_cn: 嚯，你这是典型的绿裔风格，和春鲜集市也不搭配！

say:9:1660112009:1.text: Damian, what if we stamp wood-grain and floral patterns onto the gears and brickwork? You get the look you want, and we keep the strength. Shall we meet halfway?
say:9:1660112009:1.source_cn: 达米安老师，你要是实在喜欢树木花草的话，我们其实可以在...

say:10:1660112010:1.text: But you can't hide what stone and metal feel like. It'll still make the market look like a barracks!
say:10:1660112010:1.source_cn: 但是石头和铁皮的质感很难改变，这只会让集市看起来像一个兵营！

say:11:1660112011:1.text: And what's wrong with that? A dwarf barracks is the finest sight in the world—
say:11:1660112011:1.source_cn: 兵营怎么了？矮人的兵营肯定是天底下最漂亮——

say:13:1660112012:0.text: Hello, friends! Mind if I join in?
say:13:1660112012:0.source_cn: ——嘿！朋友们！你们在热火朝天地聊什么呢？

say:7:1660114004:0.text: But the real blaze is over here! I can feel it. Your passion's blazing like a roaring flame, ready to spark at any second!

say:9:1660114005:0.text: Uh... Pretty sure that isn't passion. That's something known as rage.
say:9:1660114005:0.source_cn: 呃……我想你感受到的应该不是热情，而是一种名叫怒火的东西。

say:10:1660114006:0.text: Rage? Oh, you should save that for the Warsong Festival!
say:10:1660114006:0.source_cn: 怒火？这种东西该留给战歌节才对！

say:14:1660114010:0.text: Oh? I get it now. Our dwarf friends who've traveled from afar and our Wilder friend... seem to have very different tastes, and just can't see eye to eye, huh?
say:14:1660114010:0.source_cn: 哦！曼卡拉明白了，远道而来的矮人朋友和绿裔朋友审美不同...

say:17:1660114012:1.text: So we need some new friends to be the judge of that.
say:17:1660114012:1.source_cn: 所以我们需要一些新朋友来帮忙判断谁说的更对。

say:1:1660117001:0.text: Have you heard of the Wildborn? Recent discoveries have shed new light on their history.
say:1:1660117001:0.source_cn: 来自绿裔的朋友，你们知道雅库伯尔吗？

say:3:1660117002:0.text: Mm. Granny Dahnie told me that ten thousand years ago, a band of ancient Wildborn made a long migration from the Wildborn tribe to the Dark Forest.
say:3:1660117002:0.source_cn: 嗯，我曾听达赫妮贤者提起过。万年以前，有一群原始兽人不...

say:4:1660117003:1.text: They're believed to be the forebears of Wilders today.
say:4:1660117003:1.source_cn: 那些人应该就是如今一部分绿裔的先祖。

say:7:1660117005:1.text: That's right! We Maulers and you Wilders come from the same roots!
say:7:1660117005:1.source_cn: 没错没错！我们蛮血和你们绿裔，可能有着共同的先祖哦！

say:18:1660117013:1.text: I'd like to hear more about our ancestors. Could you give me more details?
say:18:1660117013:1.source_cn: 比起这些，我更想知道我们先祖的故事。详细一点的。

document:4:507:0.text:
To our friend far away, Merlin,

Happy Emberlight Festival. I hope you're doing well, wherever you are. Carolina, Ludovic, and the rest of us have been thinking about you.

Ever since Shemira's family settled in Whiteridge, something about this silent land has started to change. It's still a place for the undead and the forgotten, but somehow, it feels a little less cold than before. People who used to keep to themselves now gather beneath the eaves of Ludovic's manor, speaking in hushed voices, trading long-forgotten memories. Maybe that's the true gift of the Emberlight Festival this year—the return of life.

Now that the festival is here, all of us—Ludovic, Carolina, Callan, Shemira, Niru, little Daimon, and plenty of others whose names you might not remember—have gathered together at Everstill Manor. The fire crackles in the hearth, its warm light brightening up faces that once looked so lonely. We may not be able to join the living in their celebrations, nor set foot in Avalon, but in spirit, we're already there celebrating with everyone, across the boundaries of life and death.

I hope this letter reaches you, carried by the warmth of Emberlight. And may its light guide you through every step of the year ahead.

Your eternal friend,
Valka
Eve of the Emberlight Festival, at Everstill Manor
document:4:507:0.source_cn:
致我们远方的朋友，梅林：
春焰庆安乐。不知远方的你是否一切安好？我与卡列琳娜、柳博米尔等人都牵挂着你。
自雪米拉一家搬来白山，这片寂静的疆土——亡灵与活死人聚集之地，似乎也因他们的到来而多了一些……温暖。往昔独行的同伴，如今开始在柳博米尔的永寂庄园廊下轻声交谈，分享着各自尘封的记忆。这份久违的生命力，或许是春焰庆最出乎意料的礼物。
值此佳节，我们——我、柳博米尔、卡列琳娜、铐兰、雪米拉、尼汝和可爱的戴蒙，以及许多你或许叫不出名字的朋友——正聚集在永寂庄园里。幽火在壁炉中安静地燃烧，映照着不再孤单的身影。尽管我们无法亲身感受生者们热闹欢乐的庆典，也不便前往阿瓦隆，但我们的心绪早已跨越生与死的界限，与所有人一同享受这节日的氛围。
愿此信能借由春焰的暖意，平安抵达你的手中。也愿春焰的星火，为你照亮新岁的每一段旅程。
你永恒的朋友，
瓦丽卡
春焰庆前夕，于永寂庄园
